newsitem.title: USA: ADVISORY-USDA world production coffee data June 13.
newsitem.headline: ADVISORY-USDA world production coffee data June 13.

text.p: U.S. Agriculture Department said it will release its first 1997/98 world coffee production estimates in the World Agricultural Production report on June 13, after 1500 EDT/1900 GMT.

On June 27, USDA is slated to release coffee production, supply and distribution balances -- based on the production estimates released earlier -- in its bulletin Tropical Products: World Markets & Trade. The bulletin, which also publishes data on U.S. coffee trade and consumption, will be released after 1500 EDT/1900 GMT.
